_comment: CDN graphics-pipeline — LOCKED COMPOSITE workflow (API/prompt format). The brand mark is NEVER generated: SDXL only paints the background atmosphere constrained to the CDN palette; the canonical logo raster is loaded as a fixed overlay and composited on top. Determinism: fixed seed/steps/sampler/scheduler/cfg. 'Variate within guardrails' = change node 5 seed ONLY. Logo rasters must be uploaded to ComfyUI input via POST /upload/image first (render-logo.mjs produces them).

inputs.text: abstract background atmosphere only, no subject, no logo, World's-Fair mid-century-futurist geometry, directional Ben-Day halftone dot field, matte newspaper grain in the mid-tones, dark vignette edges, smooth warm-to-cool gradient from cream #faf7f0 through lavender #d7c7ee into violet #9060f0, deep purple #30006a and navy #00002a grounds, espresso #2c1206 warmth, low-elevation glassmorphism, halftone fade, restrained palette
star, logo, mark, emblem, text, letters, watermark, people, faces, photorealistic, saturated rainbow colors, green, red, orange, harsh contrast, clutter, busy, banding
